value.title: Case16.5 Conciliatory Victory
value.synopsis: Beatrice is to have a duel with another student named Chandony, after Chandony insulted Princess Charlotte. The duel is eventually called off by Princess.

value.title: Case18.5 Black Blab
value.synopsis: Team White Pigeon tries to uncover which one of them ate Chise's monaka. The culprit eventually turns out to have been a rat.

value.title: Case21.5 Dreaded Dream
value.synopsis: Ange has a dream about being alone together with Princess at Casablanca‏‎.

value.title: Busy Easy Money
value.synopsis: Team Shirohato is summoned by Dorothy and Chise to the natural history room. It seems that Dorothy has something to discuss with them... (Short anime included in the BD Volume 1.)

value.title: Revealing Reviews
value.synopsis: Team White Dove heads to the Vickers Steam Theater to search for the Caverlight bomb. Angel and Dorothy sneak into the back of the theater to search for the bomb while the princesses watch the play. When Angel and Dorothy return, they find Beatrice with an unconvinced look on her face and Chise with a pouty face... (Short anime included in the BD Volume 2.)
